text:
Maya (Design): Quick design review — focusing on batch embeddings preview + rerank table. Need take on toolbar ordering, export CTA copy, and keyboard/a11y flow. Posting current mock: https://figma.com/somefile :eyes:

Alex B (Frontend): Love the compact table. One thought: toolbar order currently [Export] [Rerank] [Filter]. I think Rerank should be first (primary) when users land from batch flow.

Josh P (Product): Agree with Alex. Most users run rerank immediately after preview. Export is secondary. Maybe primary button = "Run rerank" or "Re-rank results"?

Maya (Design): Good — naming options: "Run rerank", "Apply relevance", "Sort by relevance". Which reads best for non-ML folks?

Karla (A11y): VoiceOver users expect clear verbs. "Sort by relevance" might sound passive. "Re-rank results" is succinct but hyphenated term. "Run relevance ranking" is verbose. My vote: "Re-rank results" + aria-label="Re-rank results by relevance (opens options)"

Tom D (Data): Also ensure we surface which model/embedding vector set used in the table header — otherwise rerank is ambiguous. Add a small badge: `model: text-embed-v1` next to title.

Ezra (Design): Nice. For export CTA copy options: "Export CSV", "Download results", "Export ranked CSV". We should indicate whether the exported CSV includes score columns (similarity, original_rank).

Alex B (Frontend): We can include a toggle in the export modal: include scores? [checkbox] "Include similarity score and rank". Default = checked. CSV header suggestion:```id,query_text,matched_text,similarity_score,rank,model_version```

Josh P (Product): Make CSV column names user-friendly; i.e., `similarity_score` -> `score` and `rank` -> `relevance_rank`. But include machine-friendly names in a small help tooltip.

Karla (A11y): Keyboard behavior: toolbar should be a single tab stop, then arrow keys to cycle controls. Avoid tabbing through every small button. Also ensure dropdowns have proper aria-expanded and focus management.

Maya (Design): Good a11y guidance. UX nit: when a user toggles "Include scores" we should show inline preview column toggles so they can hide scores on the table without re-exporting. Thoughts?

Tom D (Data): Prefer export and table toggles independent. If they hide score column from table, it should still be in CSV if they choose. Avoid coupling UI state.

Alex B (Frontend): Implementation note: we'll need API support for `fields` param for export endpoint, e.g., `?fields=id,text,match,score,rank,model`. Backend already has partial support — I'll follow up with eng-runtime. @ui-bot can you file a ticket?

ui-bot: Created ticket INF-4721 "export fields param for batch preview" and linked it to thread.

Ezra (Design): Copy decision for primary: "Re-rank results". Secondary: "Export CSV". Add tiny helper text under primary: "Re-rank uses selected embedding set and model".

Karla (A11y): For helper text, ensure it's linked with `aria-describedby` so screen readers announce which model is used before running re-rank.

Maya (Design): Action items: Alex to update toolbar order & keyboard behavior, Karla to provide a11y copy for aria labels, Tom to add model badge content, Josh to sign off on CSV column names, Ezra to update Figma and helper microcopy. Will reconvene after prototypes. :+1:

Alex B (Frontend): On it — I'll push a small prototype branch this week.

Josh P (Product): I'll review CSV names and reply by EOD Thursday.

Karla (A11y): I'll draft aria strings and send a snippet.

Maya (Design): Thanks all! If anyone has quick wire tweaks, drop them in the figma link above.
